content:
maria: hitting a subtle ESM/CJS interop in the JS SDK sample when bundling for edge (vite + esbuild). Locally on Node it's fine but the edge build sometimes returns a double-wrapped module so `mod.adapter` is undefined.

aj: can you share the smallest repro and exact error you see on edge?

maria: tiny repro: conditional dynamic import between ./adapters/legacy (default export) and ./adapters/modern (named `adapter`). Build with `vite build --ssr` and deploy to Vercel Edge. Runtime error: "TypeError: Cannot read property 'adapter' of undefined" pointing at the call after `await import('./adapters/modern')`.

liam: this is classic bundler + tsconfig interop. Different toolchains create different runtime shapes: `{ adapter: fn }`, `{ default: { adapter: fn } }`, or even `default` only. `esModuleInterop`, `allowSyntheticDefaultImports`, and `module` (commonjs/esnext) all influence emitted shapes.

sam: short-term workaround for consumers: `const m = await import(path); const mod = m && (m.default ?? m); return mod.adapter ?? mod` — works across shapes but awkward. We should avoid recommending this everywhere.

aj: SDK fix proposals: 1) add a tiny helper `normalizeModuleImport<T>(m:any): T` that returns `m && (m.default ?? m)` and export TS typings so consumers keep inference; 2) update our sample adapters to export both shapes (`export const adapter = ...; export default adapter;`) to be defensive; 3) add samples with vite/rollup/webpack + tsconfig permutations so engineers can reproduce locally.

maria: I'll scaffold `samples/dx-bundler-import-matrix` with minimal apps and a README matrix showing how `esModuleInterop` + `module` change shapes. I'll include a minimal webpack config that reproduces the `Unexpected token 'export' in CJS context` parse error so SREs can reproduce.

liam: also add a CI smoke job that runs `esbuild.build({ bundle: true, write: false })` on each sample and `vm.runInNewContext` to assert `normalizeModuleImport` returns an object with expected keys. That will catch regressions early without deploying.
aj: I'll open the SDK PR for the helper + types and add a CHANGELOG entry describing the compatibility shim and guidance for conditional imports on edge.

sam: doc tip: in onboarding docs show the recommended pattern and list bundler knobs (vite: `ssr.external`/`build.rollupOptions.external`; webpack: set `type: 'javascript/auto'` for ambiguous modules or mark externals).

devx-bot: created ticket RW-1510: "dx: normalize dynamic import shapes across bundlers + samples" and assigned to @maria and @aj.

maria: thanks — will post branch link once scaffolded. If anyone has recorded odd double-wrapping shapes (e.g., `{ default: { default: { ... } } }`) paste bundler + tsconfig so we expand the test matrix. :thumbsup:
